edges.reason: transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer() core logic
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer() core logic
_transfer() settles balances and tax through _tokenTransfer()
airdrop() distributes tokens by calling _tokenTransfer() in a loop
_tokenTransfer() mutates the _balance mapping for sender, recipient and contract
grant() mints arbitrary balances into the _balance mapping
grant() adds to _tTotal with no cap, allowing uncapped supply inflation that breaks the TOTAL_SUPPLY invariant
addToWhitelist() writes the fee-exemption flag in _isExcludedFromFee
removeFromWhitelist() clears the fee-exemption flag in _isExcludedFromFee
lowerTax() writes _taxFee which is multiplied into amounts inside _tokenTransfer()
removeBuyLimit() overwrites _maxTxAmount with the full supply, disabling the buy limit
_transfer() reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the anti-whale buy limit
_transfer() applies _taxFee to every non-exempt transfer amount
_transfer() consults an external, non-verified contract O(...).amount() whose value can block users, giving a third party control over every transfer
_transfer() can reach the Uniswap swap operation when automatic swapping fires
swapTokensForEth() performs the external Uniswap swapExactTokensForETH call with amountOutMin set to zero
_transfer() triggers swapTokensForEth() and a subsequent ETH send during execution, an external call embedded in state-changing transfer flow
swapForTax() invokes swapTokensForEth() on the whole contract token balance
_transfer() calls sendETHToFee() when ETH balance exceeds TAX_THRESHOLD, sending ETH to an EOA/contract while transfer state is being updated
collectTax() forwards the whole contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee()
sendETHToFee() executes the raw ETH transfer to the tax wallet
sendETHToFee() directs contract ETH exclusively to the privileged _taxWallet
swapTokensForEth() writes router allowance through _approve()
approve() delegates allowance writing to _approve()
transferFrom() decrements the allowance via _approve() using SafeMath sub
_approve() writes the _allowances mapping
createUniswapPair() reaches the external factory.createPair() call
createUniswapPair() stores the created pair address in _pair
createUniswapPair() grants the pair contract an unlimited token approval
addLiquidity() forwards the entire contract ETH balance to the external router addLiquidityETH call
addLiquidity() sets _swapEnabled to true, activating automatic swaps in transfers
addLiquidity() sets _canTrade to true, opening trading
createUniswapPair() depends on the _canTrade state variable as a one-time guard
onlyTaxCollector() compares the caller against the single privileged _taxWallet address, centralizing all privileged operations on one key
msg.sender is the sole value checked by the onlyTaxCollector modifier
msg.sender supplies the source address flowing into _transfer() through transfer()
transfer() uses msg.sender as the debit address
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as spender when reducing the allowance, a caller-controlled authorization path
msg.sender flows into _approve() as spender when called from approve()/transferFrom()
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, a miner-influenced value
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline, a miner-influenced value
swapTokensForEth() toggles _inSwap through the lockTheSwap modifier, the guard protecting against reentrant swap paths
constructor assigns the deployer as _taxWallet and privileged recipient
constructor initializes _taxFee with INITIAL_TAX
constructor derives _maxTxAmount using SafeMath div on the total supply
constructor computes _tTotal = TOTAL_SUPPLY * 10**DECIMALS
constructor pins the Uniswap V2 router address
constructor whitelists the contract and tax wallet from fees
constructor uses msg.sender for ownership and tax wallet assignment
renounceOwnership() clears _owner while privileged tax-collector powers remain active
from parameter feeds the zero-address, fee-exemption and pair checks in _transfer()
to parameter feeds the buy-limit and fee-exemption checks in _transfer()
transfer amount parameter is passed down as the gross amount into _tokenTransfer()
tAmount parameter participates in the tax multiplication and subtraction arithmetic
taxRate parameter is multiplied with tAmount and divided by 100
airdrop amount parameter is reused for every _tokenTransfer() call with zero tax
swapForTax contract balance local flows into swapTokensForEth()
len local bounds the airdrop loop that reaches _tokenTransfer()
loop index i selects each airdrop recipient passed to _tokenTransfer()
